title: Chapter 884
paragraphs: Chapter 884
Episode 220. Unyielding (6)
Out of nowhere, the plain had turned into a deep sea, but Luna and Syris were not immobilized and unable to breathe.
As soon as the water started to rise, Luna surrounded herself with a protective shield in the form of a sphere using Ouro, and Syris also formed a similar shield with the power of Manbing.
"The dimensional door to the other-dimensional snowfield won't open, First Flagbearer."
"Space movement obstruction. Seems like they have such an ability, like Elona Zipfel."
Luna calmly observed her enemies. The enemies, strengthened by Zito's flesh, were swaggering with confidence.
An unexpected situation.
However, Luna had always faced more serious and dangerous variables when living in the Black Sea, and she moved forward.

"Then we have no choice but to fight... Well, dealing with variables is also an important ability, so let's understand this as part of our training. Sovereign, you support me while protecting yourself as much as possible."
"Understood."
"Hehehe, it must be your first time fighting underwater. Let me show you the majesty of the deep-sea area of the True Demon Realm..."
KwaAaAaAa-!
The moment Vice spoke those words, a gigantic red sword aura surged upwards, splitting the water that had filled the plain in two.
The sword aura instantly evaporated most of the water created by Vice. The steam spreading across the battlefield obscured the view for a moment, as if a cloud had descended.
"Everyone, be careful! It's a red sword aura!"
As Vice frantically shouted, Luna internally shook her head.
'It's strong, but it feels somewhat lacking in weight. Compared to Jikalro, they seem slightly lacking in both power and intelligence.'

Vice was squawking like a third-rate villain, and Kukan was recklessly shooting out sword auras, vowing to avenge the dead Sikkan. Tilius was the only one who seemed to have the weight befitting a Demon King, but he apparently didn't have the power to control his foolish comrades.
And this group definitely nailed Luna's assessment of them as 'stupid' because of one demon, Misol Huwan.
"Misol!"

As soon as Luna's sword aura destroyed the castle, he bellowed his name and rushed into the battlefield. His size was three times that of the other Demon Kings, and he brought along a giant mallet that perfectly suited his bulk.
Crash-!
Luna blocked his mallet and was momentarily taken aback. The brute force, reminiscent of a wave, was being directly transmitted through his weapon.
"Misol, Misol, Misol!"
"Ha ha ha, didn't I tell you? Our Misol might be a bit slurred, but he can never sit still when his fortress is crumbling!"
"Misol!"
"He doesn't seem to be just a little slurred, does he?"
All the Demon Kings were truly full of strength and combat power. The evaporated water quickly refilled and stirred a whirlpool, and Syris momentarily lost his center in the current.
Kukan's sword, seizing the opportunity, grazed Syris' hair. If his senses, honed from battles with the generals, had been dulled, it would have pricked his cheek, not his hair.
The Demon Kings were not affected by Vice's water at all. They were in a much better position than the two who had to fight while continuously evaporating water.
'If this drags on, it could really be dangerous. Not just the dimensional gate to the other-dimensional snowfield, but the communication device is also out of order.'
Luna was freely shooting red sword auras. She even added red sword auras when using the final move like a meteor shower, not just when spreading the heart sword.

She had never used this amount of red sword auras even when exploring the Black Sea. The more she used them, the lighter her body felt and the more awakened her senses, but a sense of unease accompanied this, as she did not know the cause.

'Vice, the one who controls water, is the most annoying. Somehow, I need to get rid of him first for things to get easier. And I need to find out who's blocking the communication device and space jump, and kill them. Anyway, if I win... I guess I'll be dealing with four pieces of Zito's flesh at once.'
Misol was confronting Luna head-on, while the other Demon Kings were circling around like snakes, waiting for an opening.

And not just weapons were flying whenever an opening appeared. Magic, high-ranking demons of the True Demon Realm were basically both superhuman-level weapon users and magic users, many were swordsmen.

Among them, most of the magic the Demon Kings were using now was dark curses. Even if a weapon flew at an angle that was hard to avoid, it was okay if you could block it, but a curse could instantly corrode the entire body the moment a sword touches it.

Luna, who doesn't have immunity to curses like Jin, had no choice but to be particularly difficult. She didn't know what the curse contained, but as it was a curse strengthened by Zito's power, she had to avoid it at all costs.
Moreover, Luna also had to protect Syris.
'It's best if Sovereign seizes the opportunity to counterattack first. Then I can break through to Vice based on that. Can Sovereign do it?'
She didn't ask Syris directly.

Because it seemed that Syris didn't even have the leisure to have a conversation now. Syris was sweating heavily, warding off all sorts of curses and Kukan's attacks that broke through Luna's protection.
Fortunately, Luna soon realized that her worry was merely groundless. As soon as her concern ended, Syris created an opportunity and seized it.
Manbing Sword Five, White.
Syris had realized faster than Luna that he was the key to this battle as soon as it started.
He understood from the beginning that Luna could move freely only when he began to counterattack.

Therefore, Syris had been preparing the "Five Aspects" of the Ice Blade. There was no solution in a typical offense and defense, so he concluded that he needed a big technique that could at least momentarily cause the Demon Kings to falter.
Pzzt-!

Suddenly, ice flowers of the Ice Blade sprouted in the middle of the battlefield. Kukan, who had been charging all along, momentarily dodged the ice flowers. The ice flowers ravaged the entire deep sea of the demon realm spread by Vice, but it did not threaten Luna at all.
"Go, 1st Horseman!"
"Very good, Lord of the Labyrinth!"
The Aspect 'White' he unfolded this time was larger in scale than when he killed the warlords, and its sharpness was also deeper.

But she could not silence the enemies at once like that time. The Demon Kings skillfully avoided the ice flowers and waited for 'White' to subside. Misol showed her strength by continuously destroying the ice flowers while shouting her name.
"Misol! Misol!"
"Hey, Misol! What are you going to do by breaking that, you need to avoid it……!”
"That idiot!"
At Misol's astonishing decision-making, Vice and Kukan screamed in shock. They knew Misol was dull, but they never thought she would fall for such an obvious trap.
Luna, ignoring Misol who was distracted by the ice flowers, swung her red Kranitel at Vice.
"Kuh!"
Vice reacted not too late and parried Kranitel, but felt a tearing pain all over his body from the red energy flowing along the sword.
'Is this the reason why Lord Phaelito was so cautious of this power……! Damn it, I'm losing consciousness just from clashing weapons! Has that idiot Misol been enduring this all this time?'
Full power.
There was no way there would be another opportunity like this again. There was no way Syris could consecutively unleash the 'White' of Five Aspects.

So Luna was pressuring Vice with all her might. Final moves and non-techniques such as the torrent, flash, meteor shower, and light speed thrust were constantly linked as if they were ordinary attacks. Of course, all of them included the red sword energy.
And there was a part where Zito's flesh worked rather as a poison in such a situation. Zito's energy was reacting to Luna's red power, increasing Vice's pain.
There was no change in the enhancement through the flesh, except that the pain was amplified. But Vice was not particularly resistant to fighting while enduring pain.
'I'm going crazy, Misol needs to keep her sanity and help me. Kukan is still blinded by the Lord of the Labyrinth…… Then, Tilius!'
Tilius!
Vice barely called his name. Tilius had moved to the other side of Vice to avoid the ice flowers, and Vice suddenly felt uneasy.
'But why didn't this bastard Tilius join me before I called him? He could have avoided the Lord of the Labyrinth's ice flowers and protected me!?'
Tilius showed a considerably reluctant movement at Vice's call. As if he had no intention of saving Vice.
Vice was in a lot of thought while being cornered.
And there wasn't a single person in the entire army who could fight Luna while 'thinking differently'. Even Shin, let alone Chiron, would focus only on Luna if he had to face her.
In other words, Vice was, in effect, sticking his neck out to fight Luna.
"Die!"

Luna, with a gleam in her eyes, focused the red sword energy spread around her on Kranitel. Luna's attack, Heart Sword Red Moon, Vice couldn't respond properly as his body had holes all over it due to the previous final moves and non-techniques.
Naturally, the speed of Luna's attacks, filled with her full power, was thousands of times faster than the rate at which his body was recovering.
In the end, Kranitel, swung at an incredible speed, cleaved Vice in two, and then completely obliterated the castle behind him.

Following the ruler of the Flaming Grounds of the Demon Realm, it was the moment when the ruler of the Deep Sea Zone became famous. As soon as Vice died, the water that was covering the battlefield vanished without a trace.

'Phew, at least one guy is down. But this red energy...... It's swirling as if it's about to run wild inside me. Is this the signal that the number of times my father mentioned is running out? But I don't feel tired like before......'

In any case, it wasn't a situation where she could fight while conserving the red energy. Even if Vice was dead, the remaining three were completely fine. Especially Misol, who took Luna's red energy head-on all along, didn't look tired at all, even after destroying the ice flowers.
'First, I have to protect the Lord of the Labyrinth again. He has unleashed the White of Five Aspects to the maximum, so he won't have the strength to properly fend off Kukan's attacks now.'
The ice flowers were wilting. The Demon Kings were pressuring Syris, and Luna paused for a moment to decide which side to break through.
Just as she was about to choose one side, Luna had to open her eyes wide in surprise.
'Huh?'
Thud-!
Tilius's sword was piercing Kukan's back.
